approximations: pbrt: directional light angularRadius is ignored (pbrt distant lights are delta lights); `L` is used as irradiance.
pbrt: material 'screen': alpha_mode mask: cut out where opacity 1 x base colour alpha (texture) < cutoff 0.5
coverage: pbrt: material 'screen': specular_weight/specular_color scale F0 only through an IOR of 1.0000 (OpenPBR scales F at both ends)
pbrt: material 'screen': base colour texture 'screen' (128x128, sRGB, wrap repeat): imagemap bilinear, which still selects a mip level from the scaled camera ray differentials
pbrt: material 'screen': alpha mask: hard cutoff at 0.5 on the bilinear alpha through a gain-1000 alpha texture (stochastic only inside a band of 0.0010 alpha units)
